steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Modern Calculator' and package identifier 'com.moderncalculator.app'.

steps.title: Create Base Build Scripts
steps.description: Initialize standard top-level and settings Gradle configuration scripts tailored for AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure Module Build Properties
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle script with compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and dependencies restricted to platform SDK.

steps.title: Establish Manifest Permissions and Declarations
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml declaring correct namespace, launcher activity MainActivity, and portrait orientations.

steps.title: Define Color Resources and Styling Guides
steps.description: Establish styling themes using default Material styles with deep obsidian dark backgrounds and crisp accents.

steps.title: Create Custom Button Drawables
steps.description: Design sleek drawable selectors with rounded shapes, gradients, and subtle hover/click responses for different button categories.

steps.title: Design Glassmorphic Calculator Display Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant dual-row display with small gray history tracking and large bold live characters with shadow effects.

steps.title: Implement Sliding Scientific Panel
steps.description: Set up a horizontal scrolling container for math functions including Sin, Cos, Tan, Log, exponents, and constants.

steps.title: Develop Recursive Descent Math Evaluator
steps.description: Write a pure-Java mathematical parser executing BODMAS/PEMDAS precedence, handling parentheses, trigonometric operations, roots, powers, and logs.

steps.title: Coordinate State Machine and Input Handlers
steps.description: Implement backspace parsing, error handling, infinite divisions checks, parenthesis balancing, and live formula validation.

steps.title: Implement Calculation History Logging
steps.description: Create local session-based persistent memory arrays to let users click historical formulas to restore them for recalculation.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and package the complete Modern Calculator application using Gradle debug tasks.
